newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RTRS-Cricket-Mark Waugh plunders century in South Africa.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Mark Waugh plunders century in South Africa.

text.p: Some explosive hitting by Mark Waugh sparked a run feast as Australia piled up 319 for three in their day/night match against South African province Boland on Tuesday.
Waugh spent his first 68 deliveries familiarising himself with South Africa's lowest, slowest wicket in reaching his half century.
His second 50 was plundered from just 25 balls and twice he struck three sixes in an over. He retired after reaching 101.
Captain Mark Taylor continued his return to form with a watchful 56 from 86 balls, Michael Bevan hit 80 not out from 66 deliveries and Justin Langer smashed 57 from just 44 balls.
